lengthening.structural_note: The only channel for (a) to lengthen a stretch vs current is an after_sellAll sample with mrAff=false while the stretch is closed, opening at fractional (or check-in) t before the next current integer open. Because sellAll weakly increases coins, post-sale unaffordable implies prior same-interval coins were also unaffordable whenever costs/candidates are unchanged; so the prior integer sample has usually already opened the stretch. Wage drain between an affordable integer and a still-unaffordable post-sale check-in is the remaining theoretical channel; it did not occur in these 440 runs.
